# Build: one module per session

Input: `<slug> <n>`. With "continue <slug>" only, take the first module in `js/project.js` with screens not built.

## 1. Context (read nothing else up front)
1. `projects/<slug>/README.md`, in full.
2. `node scripts/pk.mjs context <slug> <n>`: screens and status, module data file, component index, shared brief sections, module section.

## 2. Screens
For each screen of the module not yet built, in order:
1. `cp projects/<slug>/screens/_screen.html projects/<slug>/screens/<id>.html`, then edit only the `MK.screen({ … })` block, plus a `<script>` for the module data file right after `mock-data.js` when the module has one.
2. Render the screen's key content and detail from the brief with the indexed components and the data files. A missing component: add it to `components.js` and `components.css` and to the COMPONENT INDEX (shared files only get additions).
3. Module-only data goes in the module data file named by the context, using the ids of `js/mock-data.js`.
4. Wire navigation: links of the flows passing through this module, back button, tab bar. Link to other screens by id even when they are not built.
5. Add `built: true` to the screen's line in `js/project.js`. This is the status; a later session continues from it.

**First screen of the project** (context says "Built so far: 0"): build only that screen, then stop and ask for visual approval. Record the answer under Decisions; visual changes go into tokens and components.

Never change the screens of other modules.

## 3. Design pass (after the module's screens are built)
Refinement of this module's new screens: apply what is found, do not only report it.
1. When the `impeccable` skill is available: `/impeccable audit` on the new screens, always; `/impeccable polish` and `/impeccable harden` only in the project's first built module, in a module with forms or wizards (harden), or when asked. It is narrow refinement: the brief, the README and `tokens.css` are the product and design context; do not run `impeccable init` or create `PRODUCT.md` or `DESIGN.md`.
2. Without it, audit by hand: contrast, touch targets, text size, focus, semantics, every theme; where harden applies, try empty, long, invalid and repeated input.
- Keep the brief, the approved visual direction, the palette and the font. Findings that contradict the brief or a recorded decision are not applied; list them under Decisions with the reason.
- Fix a defect at its source: a shared component or token may change when the fault is there; check every theme and the existing screens that use it, and record the change under Decisions.

## 4. Finish
1. `js/project.js`: `updated` today; `status: 'In progress'` (or `'Review'` when every screen is built). README: new Decisions and Open questions.
2. Follow `.ai/skills/pk-check/SKILL.md` for this project, on the new screens.
3. Report in at most 6 lines: screens built, what the design pass changed, what was uncertain, what is left. Wait for "continue" unless told to run through.

Arguments: $ARGUMENTS
